name: Muhammad IX of Granada
contribution: The fifteenth Nasrid ruler of the Emirate of Granada on the Iberian Peninsula.

checks.lead: Muhammad IX (1384-1453), also known by his Arabic and Castilian nicknames Al-Aysar and El Zurdo ("The Left Handed"), was the fifteenth Nasrid ruler of the Emirate of Granada on the Iberian Peninsula.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
